title: apr serve omits the server timings block on the Qwen3.5 hybrid CUDA chat path, so replay TTFT/prefill/decode are null for apr
evidence: PRM-S1 review-replay-v1 set b8a58011 on gx10 (GB10, gpu-layers resolved=32/32 backend=cuda, server log 'qwen35 hybrid forward, #3090'), apr 0.69.5-rc.1 (5660b0877), Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M sha 00fe7986: 200/200 /v1/chat/completions replies have usage (input/output tokens) but no timings, so prompt_ms, prompt_tps and decode_tps are null in all 200 rows. llama.cpp d1d3c3396 on the same set and cell returns timings on 200/200. Timings::from_phases exists and cuda_chat_backend.rs builds PhaseTimings; the hybrid path apparently does not call it (suspected, not traced)
repro: apr serve run Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf --gpu-layers all --context-length 36864; POST /v1/chat/completions non-streaming; the reply JSON has no timings key
